events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/i2c/i2c_rtio.c` where `i2c_rtio_copy()` had `if (0)` instead of `if (sqe == NULL)` after calling `rtio_sqe_acquire(r)`. With this fix, when the SQE pool is exhausted mid-copy, `i2c_rtio_copy()` properly drops any previously acquired SQEs and returns `NULL` instead of dereferencing a `NULL` pointer. All tests in `tests/subsys/rtio/rtio_i2c` now pass on `native_sim`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
